title: Clean ~1 hour road running activity
description: Road running activity recorded 2024-03-05, 56:07 / 9.6 km, on a Garmin fenix 6 paired with five sensors: Garmin HRM Pro (heart rate), Stryd (power), Moxy (muscle oxygen), and two generic Garmin sensors. 3,369 record rows, monotonic timestamps, no duplicates. Control fixture: representative of a well-formed multi-sensor activity.
expected_behavior: Parser should return 3,369 records spanning 2024-03-05T10:03:07Z to 10:59:15Z, populate heart_rate / cadence / power / speed / altitude / temperature / distance, and report sport=running, sub_sport=road. No defect-related warnings expected.
